parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese, en: English.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the swimming lane.

parameters.name: EnableRules
parameters.description: Specifies whether to configure a routing rule for the swimming lane. You do not need to configure a routing rule for an Ingress.

parameters.name: EntryRules
parameters.description: The collection of swimming lane rules.

sub_parameters.name: Condition
sub_parameters.description: Specifies how to combine the RestItems to form the final condition.

parameters.name: GatewaySwimmingLaneRouteJson
parameters.description: The gateway routing information. This parameter is used when you use a cloud-native gateway as the ingress.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the swimming lane group.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The primary key ID. Set the value to -1 to create a swimming lane. Set the value to a number greater than 0 to modify a specific swimming lane.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the swimming lane.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the MSE namespace.

parameters.name: PathIndependentPercentageEnable
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. This parameter is a configuration item for Java gateways and is used for path-based routing by percentage.
